entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Congratulations on graduating,[n]you two!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mm, thanks.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Makoto's last big speech as council[n]president got me all teared up...
entries.uk: Остання велика промова Макото як голови[n]ради аж розчулила мене...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: *sigh* That was such a nice ceremony.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, lemme see.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okay...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You gotta do that to be officially[n]graduated!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Aren't you feeling even a bit[n]sentimental?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This year really flew by, didn't it?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We made so many memories together...[n]I might even remember those better[n]than what we did in school.
entries.uk: Ми стільки спогадів створили разом...[n]Може, я навіть краще їх пам'ятатиму,[n]ніж те, що ми робили в школі.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah. But it is gonna suck not seeing[n]you two at school anymore...
entries.uk: Ага. Але буде відстійно більше не бачити[n]вас у школі...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't worry. I'll be attending here[n]starting in April.
entries.uk: Не хвилюйтеся. З квітня я[n]ходитиму сюди.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'll be bringing the lunches, so you[n]better get psyched!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro's gonna teach me how to cook!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, right—you're gonna be here too.
entries.uk: О, точно — ти ж теж тут будеш.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't forget about me, either.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Maybe I should become a high schooler[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ooh, will you? That sounds like fun!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Perhaps I should also transfer[n]to Shujin...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Makoto-senpai, Haru-senpai!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: You came to the ceremony?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I wanted to tell you... in person...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: *huff* Congratulations on your[n]graduation!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I have an idea—why don't we take[n]a group picture?
entries.uk: У мене ідея — може, зробимо[n]спільне фото?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ooh, yeah!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And I'll serve as your cameraman.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Akechi-kun!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We haven't seen you since the pep rally.
entries.uk: Ми не бачили тебе від спортивного свята.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've been meaning to ask, what are your[n]plans after high school, Akechi-kun?
entries.uk: Я давно хотіла спитати, які твої[n]плани після школи, Акечі?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm thinking about going freelance.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Considering how busy I've been up to[n]now, I think I've earned at least a year[n]or so of taking it easy.
entries.uk: Зважаючи на те, як я був зайнятий досі,[n]думаю, я заслужив принаймні рік[n]відпочинку.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't turn into a shut-in, got it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Thanks for the warning.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Now, everyone gather up over there.
entries.uk: А тепер усі збирайтеся он там.

entries.speaker: Man Wearing Hat
entries.en: Would you rather I take that for you?

entries.speaker: Man Wearing Hat
entries.en: You're all friends, right?

entries.speaker: Man Wearing Hat
entries.en: Okay, ready?

entries.speaker: Man Wearing Hat
entries.en: Say cheese...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Thank you!
